project.name: osgi/domains/worktree/worktree-contract-host
project.description: The HOST face of the worktree contract — the dual-realm wire vocabulary BOTH realms consume: the @SeedContract WorktreeFacts (root + Provenance + WorkingState) the worktree soil harvests into the cellar at the WorktreeCoordinate, and the flat host fetches back for the GROW root and the entry gate. Same form as incus-contract-host: type=library, staged as a bundle OSGi-side AND kept flat host-side, so the host decodes WorktreeFacts into its OWN copy via the dual-realm codec — no jgit type and no service reference crosses. jgit-FREE by construction (JDK types + the seed-broker seam only).
